caption: The video captures a static nighttime close-up of a small open fire already burning on folded, yellowish paper-like pieces resting on a gray ashy base threaded with reddish glowing embers. A dark vertical pillar frames the left edge and a green cartoon logo sits fixed in the top-left corner, while faint brick-like structure on the right is intermittently lit against a black background. Throughout the excerpt the flames flicker and reshape, rising, curling, and receding rather than appearing or being extinguished. The bright flame column on the right grows taller and more vertical, casting stronger light onto the pieces and the right-side bricks. The yellow folded pieces remain static, their edges darkening and curling as the fire consumes them. The ember band glows persistently with minor intensity changes, while the pillar and logo stay fixed.
